paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用分子动力学模拟研究了熔融 LiF 的粘度，比较了 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势的表现 [S2.p1]。作者采用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力自相关函数计算粘度，并与实验值对比 [S2.p1][S2.p3]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内较好地重现实验粘度，而经典势预测的粘度偏低 [S3.p1]。作者还发现，通过简单加热晶体结构，MACE-MP-0 模拟的熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [S3.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在评估 MACE-MP-0 机器学习势在计算熔融 LiF 粘度方面的准确性，并与经典 Buckingham 和 BHM 势进行对比 [S1.p4]。研究动机源于熔融盐在太阳能电池、电解质、核反应堆冷却剂等领域的应用，而对其液态输运性质的理论理解不足，经典原子模型难以生成可靠的热物理数据 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。粘度是决定热工水力性能的关键性质，此前经典势预测的 LiF 粘度存在明显的温度偏移 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

Molten salts such as LiF have received long term and recent interest due to their use in solar cells, as electrolytes and solvents, and potential utilisation as coolant fluids in nuclear reactors, along with metals.

A thorough understanding of the thermodynamic and transport properties of molten salts and their mixtures will underlie the upscaling of the above processes to industrial scales, however this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
Viscosity is one key property governing the performance of working fluids in thermal hydraulics
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.

method.text: 作者使用经典分子动力学（DL_POLY 包，Buckingham 和 BHM 势）以及 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势（通过 janus-core 包）对熔融 LiF 进行模拟 [S2.p1]。粘度通过 Green-Kubo 方法从应力张量自相关函数的积分计算 [S2.p1]。模拟采用 NVE 系综，时间步长 1 fs，轨迹长度 1 ns，对 20 个独立初始构型取平均，系统大小为 512 个原子 [S2.p2][S2.p3]。MACE 模型基于消息传递神经网络架构，使用高阶多体 ACE 展开，训练于 MPtrj 数据集 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
In both cases we use the Green-Kubo method to calculate viscosity from the integral

For all statistics collection simulations we use the NVE ensemble with a timestep of 1 fs and a trajectory length of 1 ns, and average across 20 initial configurations each independently initialised with the same density.
In both we use a system size of N=512 atoms
The MACE model relies upon a Message Passing Neural-Network (MPNN) architecture
the MACE model utilises higher-order many-body ACE expansion for message passing
The model is trained upon the MPtrj data set introduced for CHGNet and compiled from the Material Project dataset

experiments.text: 作者在 512 原子体系中对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟，使用 NVE 系综、1 fs 时间步长、1 ns 轨迹长度，并对 20 个独立初始构型取平均 [S2.p2][S2.p3]。粘度计算采用 Green-Kubo 方法，最大相关时间设为 5 ps，并与实验粘度值进行对比 [S2.p3]。此外，作者通过从晶体结构逐步加热（10 K 至 1250 K，步长 50 K）来测定熔点，并计算了速度自相关函数、态密度、部分径向分布函数和结构因子 [S2.p2][S3.p4][S3.p5]。

In both we use a system size of N=512 atoms
For both MD methods we use the same maximum correlation time for calculating η, 5 ps.
The viscosities calculated from Eq. 1 are compared to experimental values of viscosity.
For equilibration we heat the system in the NPT ensemble from a crystal lattice structure taking temperature steps from 10 K to the desired temperature in steps of 50 K.

findings.text: MACE 模型计算的粘度在整个温度范围内与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型的粘度结果存在约 300 K 的温度偏移 [S3.p1]。通过逐步加热晶体结构，MACE 模拟的熔点与实验熔点（1121 K）吻合较好，而经典势低估熔点约 300 K，这支持了粘度偏移与熔点低估相关的观点 [S3.p2]。在动力学方面，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的速度自相关函数表现出更深的极小值，且两者形状相似，表明液态中类固态振荡成分更显著 [S3.p4]。结构上，MACE 的径向分布函数峰高略低、峰位略高，表明配位环境更宽 [S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models
the simulated viscosity matches the experimental viscosity well, albeit with the latter at a temperature around 300 K higher.
We observe good agreement between the experimental melting temperature and the melting temperature of the MACE simulation.
the poor reproduction of the experimental viscosity in simulations governed by the Buckingham and BHM models is related to the underestimation of the the melting temperature by approximately 300 K
Both Li and F atoms exhibit a much deeper minima in the MACE VAFs, approximately equal in magnitude.
deeper minima in MACE systems imply more pronounced solidlike component of the liquid motion.
the MACE peak heights slightly lower and the peak positions slightly higher than those of the classical RDFs.
The reduction in magnitude indicates a somewhat broader coordination environment simulated by the MACE model than the classical model

limitations.text: 作者指出，通过简单加热晶体结构确定熔点可能并不普遍准确，因为周期性边界条件、小系统尺寸等因素会影响熔点，更可靠的方法如计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等可用于测试 MACE 势的熔点性能，但这是未来工作 [S3.p3]。此外，由于计算资源限制，MACE-MP-0 无法使用更大系统来增加计算截断半径以观察 RDF 的更多峰 [S3.p5]。作者还提到，虽然结果支持熔点低估导致粘度偏移的假设，但系统尺寸和缺乏界面等其他效应也可能有贡献 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point and other methods such as calculating the free energies of solid and liquid phases, simulating phase co-existence and so on can be used instead.

The performance of MACE potentials for determining the melting point can be tested using these approaches, however the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.

In order to increase the calculation cutoff radius and see the peaks reduce further and the g(r) tend to 1 we would need a larger system. For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.
